desc:
Welcome to +1 Football for Brainrots ⚽🧠

Train harder, kick farther, and collect the rarest Brainrots! Build up insane Power, launch your football across huge distances, and race to claim the best brainrots before time runs out! 💥

How to play:
💪 Train to increase your Power
⚽ Kick the football farther to reach better Brainrots
🏃 Upgrade your Speed to travel farther before the timer ends
🏋️ Buy heavier Weights to gain Power even faster
🗼 Upgrade your Tower to kick from greater heights
💵 Collect Brainrots to earn Cash and grow your collection

💤 Your Brainrots generate Cash even while OFFLINE!

♻️ Rebirth to multiply your earnings and become even stronger!

🔥 Unlock powerful new Brainrots, and reach the highest tiers!

👍 Like the game and join the group for FREE rewards!
